content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 Porkbun: Live Technical Support Representative — Full-Time — $40,000/year + Benefits (Sat-Sun required) (Location: Remote, U.S.-based) Anywhere in the World 🇺🇸 United States of America Oregon Technical Support, Web Support, Customer Support, Phone Support, and Customer Service Customer Support Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0064/5136/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Oregon USA <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://porkbun.com">https://porkbun.com</a> </p> <p><strong>Live Technical Support Representative — Full-Time —&nbsp; $40,000/year + Benefits (Sat-Sun required) (Location: Remote, U.S.-based)</strong></p> <p>It's time to hire another amazing individual again. You could be the pick of the litter! Are you a resourceful problem solver who loves delivering top-notch customer service? Can you provide amazing and personalized phone support? If you’re good at diagnosing technical issues, enjoy helping customers, and can deliver a mind-blowing experience via phone, chat, and email support, then please apply!</p> <p>Porkbun is a fully remote domain name registrar. We’re looking to add multiple U.S.-based, full-time Technical Support Representatives. Applicants must be based in the USA and eligible for employment.</p> <p>From .com to .pizza to .plumbing, Porkbun sells more than 500 domain extensions directly to consumers. Our no-nonsense interface and super-affordable prices mean we’re adding new customers at a fantastic rate. We have become the go-to registrar for tech-savvy individuals such as developers. At the same time, bargain-hunters are thrilled to learn that we offer incredible support despite our industry-low prices.</p> <p>We think Porkbun.com is the best registrar in the world, and if you check out our TrustPilot reviews, you’ll see that’s not just our own bias talking. But even the easiest-to-use interface can’t solve every customer problem.</p> <p>Typical issues:</p> <ul> <li> <p>“How do I connect my domain to Shopify?”</p> </li> <li> <p>“How do I transfer my domain to Porkbun?”</p> </li> <li> <p>“My website isn’t working.”</p> </li> <li> <p>“How do I purchase WordPress hosting?”</p> </li> <li> <p>“Why didn’t my payment go through?”</p> </li> <li> <p>“How do I connect my hosted email to Outlook?”</p> </li> <li> <p>“Why is your company named Porkbun?”</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience –&nbsp; professional or personal – with domains, hosting, DNS is required, or, absent that, very strong experience in live technical support.&nbsp;</strong> We are looking for someone with proven technical and diagnostic ability who loves learning new things. Live support experience that spans multiple modes of support, such as email, chat, and phone, is valued.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Important skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>You can provide amazing live support via phone and chat, even in the face of customer stress, tantrums, and disasters of their own making (and sometimes ours )</p> </li> <li> <p>You can write emails with a professional tone</p> </li> <li> <p>You love the feeling of making a customer happy</p> </li> <li> <p>You’re an excellent problem solver</p> </li> <li> <p>You have at least two years of tech support experience, either at an internal help desk or customer-facing position</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience with domains, DNS, or hosting</p> </li> <li> <p>You have a steady Internet connection and a quiet room to work out of</p> </li> <li> <p>You work efficiently in a remote work environment</p> </li> <li> <p>You are perfectly fine with horrible hilarious puns</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation: </strong>Starting pay: $40,000 / year + benefits. Applicants with multiple years of professional experience in a domain registrar or hosting company may be eligible for a higher starting salary.</p> <p>This position offers full medical, dental, and vision benefits (single), starting after 90 days; optional Spouse or Family medical receives a 50% employer contribution. A simple IRA plan with a matching 3% company contribution is available after the first year.</p> <p><strong>How to apply:&nbsp;</strong>If the above describes you, please follow the instructions below <strong>EXACTLY</strong> and respond accurately -- failure to do so means we will filter out your application.</p> <ul> <li> <p>Attach your resume and cover letter to an email as two separate .pdf documents</p> </li> <li> <p>Address your email with the subject line “Technical Support Representative”</p> </li> <li> <p>Begin your email body by copying, pasting, and responding to the below qualifying questions. If you are responding NO, we are sorry, but you are not eligible for the role:</p> </li> <ul> <li> <p>Are you based in the USA and eligible for employment (Yes/No)?</p> </li> <li>Do you have two or more years of live technical support experience, or experience with domains, DNS, hosting (Yes/No)?</li> <li> <p>Are you available and interested in working both Saturday and Sunday(Yes/No)?</p> </li> </ul> <li> <p>Feel free to add other relevant, brief content to your email but it must begin with those questions and your accurate responses</p> </li> <li> <p>Send that email with attachments to careers+support@porkbun.com</p> </li> </ul> <p>We are leaning into our growth and hiring for shifts that will bolster our live support coverage for US time zones. Answering phones and chats will be the primary priority of this role.</p> <p class="c1"><span class="c3">We are hiring for the following s</span><span class="c3">tandard shifts (all times Pacific): &nbsp;</span></p> <p>We are hiring for the following shift. Available Shifts:</p> <ul> <li>Saturday - Wednesday 9 AM - 5 PM Pacific Time, and</li> <li>Thursday - Monday, 9 AM - 5 PM Pacific Time</li> </ul> <p>We believe that to do your job well, you need to take paid breaks – all 8-hour shifts include a total of one hour of paid breaks.</p> <p><strong>Our hiring process: </strong>We run a three-round interview process. Your interview process is run by the role’s direct manager, and culminates in an interview with our CEO. Before round 1 you'll need two professional references, including at least one direct manager. We don't contact them until after round 3, but having them ready is required to move forward. After round 3, as we check your references we invite you to check ours: you can choose to interview any other current Porkbun employee.</p> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/porkbun-live-technical-support-representative-full-time-40-000-year-benefits-sat-sun-required-location-remote">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/porkbun-live-technica
